title: Human in the Loop
premise: Alex keeps rewriting his LinkedIn headline as the assistants take over his work. One job still needs him to click a button.

scenes.label: profile
scenes.anchor: Why is Opus on my LinkedIn?
scenes.description: Opus 5.5 appears in Alex’s LinkedIn notifications. The profile headline reads SENIOR DEVELOPER.

scenes.label: tasks
scenes.description: Three Jira issues turn green. A line strikes through SENIOR DEVELOPER.

scenes.label: prompts
scenes.description: Alex types PROMPT ENGINEER into the same field.

scenes.label: own
scenes.description: Astra speaks. PROMPT ENGINEER gets crossed out.

scenes.label: supervise
scenes.description: Alex replaces his headline with AI SUPERVISOR.

scenes.label: review
scenes.description: The Review Loop diff flashes up. AI SUPERVISOR gets crossed out.

scenes.label: left
scenes.description: Alex puts his hand to his forehead. His crossed-out headline stays in place.

scenes.label: approve
scenes.description: An Approve button appears. Alex sits down and clicks. The tally climbs through 1, 12 and 340. The headline types HUMAN IN THE LOOP. He keeps clicking until the cut.
